{{- /* creator/growth.html — growth stage from tags only (arch/26 §1.3). Input: normalized tag list (creator/tags.html). Output: seedling | budding | evergreen. Most mature stage wins; no stage tag → seedling. Frontmatter growth/stage/status is ignored. */ -}} {{- $stage := "seedling" -}} {{- $set := dict -}} {{- range . -}}{{- $set = merge $set (dict (lower .) true) -}}{{- end -}} {{- if index $set "evergreen" -}} {{- $stage = "evergreen" -}} {{- else if index $set "budding" -}} {{- $stage = "budding" -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $stage -}}
